patthana16.79:1.1: bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.79:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassana sappaṭigho na na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ
